sources.entry: Ziit - The Swiss army knife of code time tracking (alternative to WakaTime). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Ziit is a self-hostable, open-source alternative to WakaTime that tracks coding time from IDE plugins and shows it on a minimal dashboard.
summary.what_it_does: Ziit collects coding activity such as projects, languages, editors, files, git branches, and operating systems, along with time spent coding. Data is stored on the user's own server. The dashboard offers filtering by time range and is styled after Plausible Analytics. Users can log in with GitHub or email and password. Data can be imported from WakaTime or a WakAPI instance. The project also provides README badges showing coding time, a public stats page for the whole instance, and a public leaderboard of coding hours. The README lists a VS Code extension and JetBrains support for IDE tracking.
use_cases: replace WakaTime with a private server
view coding statistics by project or language
embed coding time badge in a README
run a public coding hours leaderboard
how_to_run: Create a .env file from .env.example and set the values
notable: Alternative to WakaTime that keeps all data on the user's own server
Imports existing data from WakaTime or WakAPI
Public stats page and leaderboard for an instance
Supports GitHub login as well as email and password
caveats: Development setup requires Bun and a TimescaleDB database
README says more features are planned ('More to come...')
Supported IDEs are VS Code (including forks) and JetBrains
